shortcut_name: direct reduction to bipartite graph coloring
evidence: "color[v] = 1 - color[u]"; "Check if graph is bipartite using BFS"; all solutions build an undirected adjacency list and perform BFS/DFS two-coloring
affordance_in_statement: The arms must be connected to one of two distinct power grids... any pair of arms with overlapping ranges must be connected to different power grids.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove this reduction: assigning one of two labels while requiring every listed pair to receive different labels is intrinsically bipartite 2-coloring. Re-presenting the story or using different terminology will not remove the affordance.

common_affordance: The constraints are exactly an undirected graph 2-coloring problem: every listed pair must receive different labels from two available labels.
recommended_edit: No valid edit can defeat all survivors while preserving the task. Any wording change that retains two grids and the requirement that every listed pair receive different grids remains exactly bipartite 2-coloring.
